name: Palpitex – Resultados das Loterias
author: palpitex

sections.description:
Palpitex – Resultados das Loterias adds free, always up-to-date lottery widgets to any WordPress site: news portals, blogs and lottery shop sites. The results are published minutes after each draw, from the official data, with no work for your newsroom.

Ten widgets

  • Results – the latest result of each lottery you choose.
  • Next draw – date, time and estimated prize of the next draws, including special draws.
  • Jackpots – the lotteries with no top-prize winner for 3 or more draws, one at a time in a carousel: the jackpot ladder, the estimated prize and the next draw.
  • Which one is worth it – the lotteries ranked by the Palpitex Attractiveness Index (IAP).
  • Mega da Virada – the countdown and the estimated prize.
  • Loteca – the 14 matches with team crests and, after the games, the result.
  • Loteria Federal – the 5 winning tickets of the latest draw.
  • Ticket checker – your readers type their numbers and check them against the latest result.
  • Number generator – quick-pick numbers for the chosen lottery.
  • Your region – the latest prizes won in your city or state, with the lottery shop.

Three ways to add them

  • The Palpitex block in the block editor, with a live preview. It works for every role of your newsroom, Authors and Contributors included: the widget is generated when the page is displayed, so WordPress never strips it.
  • The [palpitex] shortcode, for the classic editor and page builders (Elementor, WPBakery and others): [palpitex widget="resultados" loterias="mega-sena,quina,lotofacil" tema="escuro"].
  • The Palpitex widget in Appearance → Widgets, for sidebars and footers.

Built for news sites

  • The widget height adjusts to its content by itself, also with performance plugins that delay JavaScript (WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, Perfmatters, Flying Scripts, WP Meteor, Cloudflare Rocket Loader).
  • Light and dark themes.
  • No cookies, no tracking and no ads inside the widgets.
  • Lightweight: one small script (about 2 KB) and lazy-loaded frames.

Palpitex Partners

If you take part in the Palpitex Partners program, write your partner handle in Settings → Palpitex: sign-ups that come from your widgets count for you. Learn more at palpitex.com.br/parceiros.

Em português

Widgets gratuitos com os resultados das loterias, os próximos sorteios, o conferidor, o gerador de palpites e os prêmios da sua região, atualizados minutos depois de cada sorteio. Use o bloco “Palpitex”, o shortcode [palpitex] ou o widget “Palpitex” em Aparência → Widgets. O plugin já vem traduzido para o português do Brasil.

Palpitex is an independent service and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Caixa Econômica Federal. Lottery names are used only to identify the results shown.

External services

This plugin displays content from Palpitex (https://palpitex.com.br), a free Brazilian lottery results service. It cannot work without it.

  • The widgets. Each widget is an iframe loaded from https://palpitex.com.br/widget/… when a visitor views a page that contains it. The visitor’s browser requests the widget page and its data from palpitex.com.br and cdn.palpitex.com.br, which, like any web server, receive the visitor’s IP address and browser information. The widgets set no cookies, store nothing in the browser and load no analytics or ads. The iframe address carries the widget options you chose and, if you set one, your partner handle.
  • The list of cities (“Your region” widget). While an editor configures this widget, your WordPress server requests the list of cities of the chosen state from https://palpitex.com.br/api/widget-cidades/{state} and keeps it for 30 days. Nothing about your visitors or your site is sent, except the site address in the request’s user agent. This never happens on public pages.
  • Credit link. Off by default. If you turn it on in Settings → Palpitex, a small link to palpitex.com.br is shown below each widget.

Palpitex terms of use: https://palpitex.com.br/termos-de-uso
Palpitex privacy policy: https://palpitex.com.br/politica-de-privacidade
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New, search for “Palpitex” and click Install, then Activate. Or upload the palpitex folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it.
  2. Optional: go to Settings → Palpitex to choose the default theme, your partner handle and whether to show the credit link.
  3. Add the “Palpitex” block to a post or page, use the [palpitex] shortcode or add the “Palpitex” widget to a sidebar.
sections.faq:
Is it free?

Yes. The plugin and the widgets are free.

How often are the results updated?

Minutes after each official draw. Nothing to do on your side: the widgets always show the latest data.

Which shortcode options are there?

widget (resultados, proximo-sorteio, acumulados, iap, virada, loteca, federal, conferidor, gerador, regiao), loterias (comma-separated: mega-sena, quina, dupla-sena, mais-milionaria, lotofacil, lotomania, timemania, dia-de-sorte, super-sete; also loteca and loteria-federal in proximo-sorteio; in acumulados it filters which lotteries may appear), loteria (one lottery, for conferidor and gerador), limite (how many items), uf and cidade (regiao), modo (loteca: jogos or resultado), tema (claro or escuro) and parceiro (partner handle). Preview every option at https://palpitex.com.br/widget.

My reporters are Authors. Can they add widgets?

Yes. The block and the shortcode work for every role, because the widget is generated by the plugin when the page is displayed. A raw iframe pasted by an Author would be removed by WordPress; the block is not.

The widget is cut or has blank space below it

The height adjusts by itself a moment after the widget loads. If your theme or a performance plugin removes the plugin’s script, the widget keeps a fixed height that fits its content.

Does it work with AMP?

The official AMP plugin converts the widget frames to AMP frames. Dedicated AMP support is planned.

1.0.0

  • First version: block, shortcode and sidebar widget with the ten Palpitex widgets, automatic height, light and dark themes, partner handle and Brazilian Portuguese translation.
